propositions: Existing container criteria G3 and G4 do not detect layer-cake decomposition (children partitioned by architectural layer instead of vertical slices) or consumed-artifact-without-ordering-edge shapes (sibling dependencies without ordering edges).

A new advisory agent-tier container criterion 'decomp-shape' must be registered in CANONICAL_LLM and AGENT_TIER (not CODEBASE_GROUNDED) with facet 'container' and added to CONTAINER_CRITERIA for dispatch via pass1_container.

The criterion requires routing configuration (exec:AGENT, facet:container, scope:[container], default_posture:advisory, block_threshold:0.95) and a rubric prompt at plan_review_decomp_shape.md with sub-answers has_container_decomposition and decomposition_shape_sound.

Blocking promotion is deferred by a dual gate: (1) effectiveness recording must show high detection and low false-positive rates, AND (2) E6 order-sensitivity must clear the floor (fleiss_kappa >= 0.6), currently a prerequisite failure at 0.55.
Eval_solver must extend to run container criteria over fixtures with children: lists via pass1_container for bounded sanity validation (maximum one live container call per fixture).

Bounded sanity fixtures (layer-cake, consumed-artifact-without-ordering-edge as positives; vertical-slice, ordered producer/consumer as negatives) must demonstrate recall 1.0 on positives and zero false-accepts on negatives, with advisory posture preventing any blocking.
